FAQ.label: How do I join a department?
FAQ.answer: To join a department, check the department information and application channels for available applications. Make sure you meet the department's requirements before applying.

FAQ.label: How do I become staff?
FAQ.answer: Staff applications are opened when Tallahassee Roleplay is hiring. Check the staff announcements for current requirements and application instructions. Applicants may also be required to complete an interview.

FAQ.label: How do I appeal a ban or blacklist?
FAQ.answer: If you believe a ban or blacklist was issued incorrectly, you can submit an appeal through the appropriate support system. Include your username, the action taken, and a clear explanation for why you believe it should be reconsidered.

FAQ.label: How do I report a player?
FAQ.answer: Submit a player report through the support system. Include the player's username, what happened, when it happened, and any available evidence such as screenshots or recordings.

FAQ.label: How do I report a staff member?
FAQ.answer: If you believe a staff member violated the rules or abused their position, submit a staff report through the support system. Include the staff member's username, what happened, and any available evidence.

FAQ.label: How do I join a session?
FAQ.answer: Session announcements will be posted in the designated session or announcement channels. Follow the instructions provided by the session host when a session is announced.

FAQ.label: Where can I find the server rules?
FAQ.answer: The official Tallahassee Roleplay rules can be found in the designated rules or information channel. All members are expected to read and follow the rules before participating.
